svg.title: Copywriter — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as copywriter, wearing a plain work shirt. Visible work cue: A manuscript shows two text rules and a visible editorial insertion mark beside a writing pen. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a bob haircut, a rounded face.
